out_of_schema_notes: Classification is a result of the study, so every parameter_type is 'unclassified'. No set-point or NOR of the step changed at Version 2.0 (the plan's setup asserts it, and the plan uses one NOR throughout), so ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the values of the parameter table, which are also the values in force. ProcessParameter.PAR carries the range studied, as everywhere in the corpus. The plan claims no proven acceptable range and draws no design space, so there are no ProvenAcceptableRange or DesignSpace records; how the ranges and the operating region will be derived is in statements. The four multivariate parameters are also anchored on their row of the coded factor table.

The step forms no quality attribute: the drug substance register assigns none to it (an ExplicitNonClaim). The QualityAttribute records are the five attributes in scope, formed upstream and cleared at this step; their acceptance_criteria are the drug substance criteria of the attribute table. Aggregate, host cell protein and fragments are responses of the designs; residual DNA and leached Protein A are measured across the step and are not (an ExplicitNonClaim). The step criteria are attribute_has_acceptance_criterion assertions and statements on the rows of the table of intermediate acceptance criteria.

acceptance_criteria holds the rows of the criteria-change table: the Version 1.0 analysis limits of aggregate and host cell protein (superseded) and the Version 2.0 criteria (in force); fragments had no Version 1.0 criterion. All three outputs with a criterion are quality attributes judged on a single batch. The host cell protein criterion was widened when PCR-008 verified the anion exchange worst case; the plan's account of the derivation and of the bound is in statements.

studies holds the scale-down model qualification and the screening, response-surface and univariate studies, each on its row of the execution-window table and on the sentences that describe it. The screening and response-surface records are also anchored on every row of their planned design matrix (Appendices A and B); the sixteen factorial rows read alike in both matrices. The qualification compares scale-down runs with manufacturing-scale batches, which is not a design, so it has no n_runs, and its responses are the outputs as the plan names them (plate count and peak asymmetry have no response key). The designs list the responses the plan states: fragments are a response of the response-surface design only, by nrCE-SDS, the one fragment result the plan judges, so no SEC fragment response is listed. The univariate study has no n_runs: the plan states its settings, not a run count, and its responses are those the plan lists. PCR-007 records no study outside the plan as a discrepancy.

Each AnalyticalMethod record is anchored on its sentence of the analytical methods section and on its row of the procedures table; the concept of a method carries the title of its validation as canonical name.

The platform worst cases of the step that the criteria upstream rely on are statements anchored on the rows of the worst-case table: they are assumptions of upstream criteria, not criteria of this step, and their verification is a result of PCR-007, not of the plan.

parameter_impacts_attribute and parameter_does_not_significantly_impact_attribute assertions are the plan's stated expectations from prior knowledge, not results. The expected interaction of protein load and load/wash conductivity on host cell protein has no predicate of its own; it is cited by the assertion of load/wash conductivity on host cell protein and stated in a statement.

The temperature-controlled chromatography chamber EQ-CHR-118 is the instrumented system the record names for the response-surface study; it is an Equipment record with a step_uses_equipment assertion. The commercial column is an Equipment record at the receiving site, anchored on the sentence that names it and on the roles-table row of the receiving site.
The first proven acceptable range analysis is recorded as the plan states it: the other factors held at the centre of the design, which at this step is the set-point of every factor.
Each row of the roles table and of the coded factor table is a statement. The approvals table and the abbreviations are not represented. No rhetorical_spans: a plan has none. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: Step 7 of the A-Mab drug substance train and its principal polishing operation, operated in bind and elute mode. Below its isoelectric point the antibody binds the sulfonate ligand of the resin, and it is eluted by raising the pH of the elution buffer. Aggregate is retained more strongly and elutes later than monomer, so the step is the principal aggregate polishing operation of the train. Host cell protein, DNA and leached Protein A carry a net negative charge at the load pH and are cleared. The feed is the neutralized pool of the low-pH viral inactivation step, and the eluate pool carries every response of the study.
input_materials: neutralized pool of the low-pH viral inactivation step
equipment: laboratory column, the scale-down model of the commercial column

assertions.assertion_text: A higher protein load is expected to lower aggregate clearance: as ligand occupancy rises the monomer and the aggregate peak broaden and overlap further.

heading_path: Prior knowledge and quality risk basis
source_references.quote: Rising ligand occupancy is therefore expected to move aggregate clearance, host cell protein clearance and yield in the same direction, all three falling as load rises.

heading_path: Prior knowledge and quality risk basis
source_references.quote: As occupancy rises the monomer and the aggregate peak both broaden and overlap further, and a larger share of the host cell protein is held on the column through its association with the bound antibody, so that it escapes the wash and elutes with the antibody.

heading_path: Prior knowledge and quality risk basis
source_references.quote: Protein load, elution buffer pH and elution stop collect each move the aggregate peak relative to the point at which collection stops, and protein load acts with the load/wash conductivity to set how much weakly bound host cell protein survives the wash, so the effects of the four on the pool cannot be assumed to add.

assertions.assertion_text: A higher load/wash conductivity is expected to strip more of the weakly bound host cell protein during the wash, and to remove more host cell protein at a high load than at a low one.

heading_path: Prior knowledge and quality risk basis
source_references.quote: A higher conductivity is expected to strip more of the weakly bound host cell protein during the wash, while the antibody, which binds more strongly, stays bound.

heading_path: Prior knowledge and quality risk basis
source_references.quote: At a high load more host cell protein is held in association with the bound antibody, and a higher ionic strength weakens that association, so a higher load/wash conductivity is expected to remove more host cell protein at a high load than at a low one.

heading_path: Prior knowledge and quality risk basis

assertions.assertion_text: A higher elution buffer pH is expected to reduce the resolution on which aggregate clearance depends, bringing monomer and aggregate off the column earlier and closer together.

heading_path: Prior knowledge and quality risk basis

assertions.assertion_text: Stopping collection later, at a lower stop collect setting, is expected to carry the leading part of the aggregate peak into the pool.

heading_path: Prior knowledge and quality risk basis
source_references.quote: Stopping collection later therefore recovers more monomer from the tail and carries the leading part of the aggregate peak into the pool, and stopping earlier leaves both behind.

assertions.assertion_text: Stopping collection later is expected to recover more monomer from the tail of the peak; monomer that elutes after the stop collect point is lost on the trailing edge.

assertions.assertion_text: A later stop of collection is expected to lower the fragment content of the pool, because it adds more of the trailing eluate, which carries few fragments.

source_references.quote: Both lower the fragment content of the pool.

assertions.assertion_text: Over the range studied, the change in peak sharpness that elution flow rate produces is expected to be too small to move the aggregate content of the pool.
